rows.label: Withholding on dividends, interest and royalties (impozit reținut la sursă) [national]
rows.value: Residents: dividends 16%, interest 10% (final). Non-residents: 16% on dividends, interest and royalties (10% for individuals resident in the EU or a treaty state on interest and royalties; 50% when paid to non-cooperative states). Paid by the payer withholds it for the recipient. Fiscal Code art. 43, 97, 223 and 224.
rows.note: Checklist item A6; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 223 alin. (1) and art. 224 alin. (4)

rows.label: Rental income and pension income (venituri din cedarea folosinței bunurilor; venituri din pensii) [national]
rows.value: Rent: 10% of the rent less a 20% flat deduction (8% effective); pensions: 10% on the part above RON 3,000 a month. Paid by landlords; pensioners (withheld by the pension payer). Fiscal Code art. 84, 100 and 101.
rows.note: Checklist item A7; detailed table: capital-income

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 84

rows.label: Non-resident tax on employment income (impozitul pe venitul salarial al nerezidenților) [national]
rows.value: 10% on net salary from work done in Romania, as for residents; full worldwide taxation from the day of arrival once present more than 183 days in 12 months, unless a treaty decides otherwise. Paid by non-resident employees working in Romania (withheld by a Romanian employer, self-declared monthly when the employer is abroad). Fiscal Code art. 7 pct. 28, 59 and 82.
rows.note: Checklist item A8; detailed table: non-resident

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 59

rows.label: Social security contributions (contribuții sociale obligatorii) [national]
rows.value: CAS 25% and CASS 10% withheld from gross pay, no ceiling; employer CAM 2.25%. Paid by employees (CAS 25%, CASS 10%) and employers (CAM 2.25%). Fiscal Code title V (art. 138 and 220^3).
rows.note: Checklist item B1

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 138, 139 and 156

rows.label: Employer levies: work insurance contribution (contribuția asiguratorie pentru muncă (CAM)) [national]
rows.value: 2.25% of gross pay; the only general employer contribution (pension and health contributions are paid by the employee). Paid by employers. Fiscal Code art. 220^1 to 220^7.
rows.note: Checklist item B2

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 138 lit. b)-c) and art. 220^3

rows.label: Self-employed contributions (CAS și CASS datorate de persoanele fizice autorizate) [national]
rows.value: CAS 25% on 12 or 24 minimum wages (optional below 12); CASS 10% on 6 to 72 minimum wages; 2026 minimum wage for the bases RON 4,050. Paid by self-employed (PFA) and other independent earners. Fiscal Code art. 148 and 170.
rows.note: Checklist item B3

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 135^1 alin. (3), art. 148 and art. 151

rows.label: Contractor rules: independent-activity test and withholding on contractor payments (activitate independentă (art. 7 pct. 3)) [national]
rows.value: Independent activity needs at least 4 of 7 criteria; no general withholding on contractor fees (the contractor pays 10% by annual return); 10% final withholding on intellectual property income (after a 40% flat deduction) and on sports contracts. Paid by clients paying individuals. Fiscal Code art. 7 pct. 3, 68^1 and 72.
rows.note: Checklist item B3b; detailed table: contractor-rules

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 7 pct. 3

rows.label: Corporate income tax (impozitul pe profit) [national]
rows.value: 16%; minimum turnover tax 0.5% in 2026 for turnover above EUR 50 million; banks pay an extra 4% turnover tax in 2026 (2% below a 0.2% market share); 5% of receipts minimum for nightclubs, discos and casinos. Paid by Romanian companies and permanent establishments of foreign companies. Fiscal Code art. 17, 18, 18^1 and 46^1.
rows.note: Checklist item C1; detailed table: corporate-tax

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 17 and 18

rows.label: Local business taxes and permit fees (taxe pentru eliberarea autorizațiilor; taxa pentru afișaj; impozitul pe spectacole) [municipal]
rows.value: Operating authorisation for restaurants, bars and recreation up to RON 4,000 (500 m²) or RON 8,000 a year; advertising displays up to RON 32 or 23 per m²; tax on shows up to 2% or 5% of receipts. Paid by businesses. Fiscal Code art. 475, 478 and 481.
rows.note: Checklist item C2

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 475 and 486

rows.label: Simplified regime: micro-enterprise turnover tax (impozitul pe veniturile microîntreprinderilor) [national]
rows.value: 1% of turnover (from 1 January 2026); PFA income norms (norma de venit) for listed activities. Paid by companies with turnover up to EUR 100,000 and at least one employee. Fiscal Code art. 47 to 57 and 69.
rows.note: Checklist item C3

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 47, 51 and 52

rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits (sediu permanent; impozitul pe dividende; impozitul pe reprezentanțe) [national]
rows.value: No branch profits tax (branches pay 16% profit tax); 16% dividend withholding (exempt for 10% holdings held one year); representative offices of foreign companies RON 18,000 a year. Paid by branches of foreign companies; companies paying dividends; representative offices. Fiscal Code art. 43, 223 (2) and 236.
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 223 alin. (2)

rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (taxa pe valoarea adăugată (TVA)) [national]
rows.value: 21% standard, 11% reduced; small-business exemption up to RON 395,000 a year. Paid by consumers (collected by VAT-registered businesses). Fiscal Code art. 291 and 310.
rows.note: Checklist item D1

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 291 alin. (1)-(2) and art. 310 alin. (1), (6)

rows.label: Local sales tax (taxă locală pe vânzări) [national]
rows.value: None: no regional or local sales or consumption tax in the Fiscal Code's list of taxes. Paid by no one. Fiscal Code art. 2.
rows.note: Checklist item D2

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 2

rows.label: Excise duties (accize) [national]
rows.value: 2026: beer RON 5.83 per hl per degree Plato; still wine RON 11 per hl; ethyl alcohol RON 5,848.49 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes RON 718.97 per 1,000 (from 1 April); unleaded petrol RON 3,059.80 and diesel RON 2,804.29 per 1,000 litres; sugar-sweetened drinks RON 48.40 or 72.60 per hl. Paid by producers and importers (passed on to consumers). Fiscal Code title VIII, annexes 1 and 2.
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise-environment

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), title VIII, art. 342 and annex 1

rows.label: Digital services, insurance premium or financial transaction tax (impozit pe servicii digitale, prime de asigurare sau tranzacții financiare) [national]
rows.value: No digital services, insurance premium or financial transaction tax in the Fiscal Code's list; credit institutions pay an additional 4% tax on turnover in 2026 (2% for a market share below 0.2%). Paid by credit institutions (turnover tax). Fiscal Code art. 2 and 46^1.
rows.note: Checklist item D4

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 46^1 (printed 461), title II^1 'Impozit suplimentar'

rows.label: Energy taxes: excise on electricity and natural gas (accize la energie electrică și gaz natural) [national]
rows.value: Electricity RON 2.37 per MWh (business use) or RON 4.74 (non-business); natural gas for heating RON 1.52 per GJ (non-business). Paid by suppliers (passed on to consumers). Fiscal Code title VIII, annex 1.
rows.note: Checklist item D5

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), title VIII, art. 342 and annex 1

rows.label: Property tax: buildings and land (impozitul pe clădiri și impozitul pe teren) [municipal]
rows.value: Residential buildings 0.08% to 0.2% of the taxable value (area × RON per m²); non-residential 0.2% to 1.3% (5% if not revalued for 5 years); land by area, locality rank and zone (e.g. RON 8,282 to 20,706 per ha, zone A, rank 0); rates set by each local council. Paid by owners of buildings and land. Fiscal Code art. 455 to 467.
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 457

rows.label: Property tax: tax on constructions (impozitul pe construcții) [national]
rows.value: 0.5% of the net book value (0.25% of constructions held under concession or similar rights on public property). Paid by companies owning constructions not subject to building tax. Fiscal Code art. 496 to 499.
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 498

rows.label: Property transfer tax (impozitul pe venitul din transferul proprietăților imobiliare) [national]
rows.value: 3% of the transaction value for property held up to 3 years, 1% above; no tax on gifts between relatives up to the third degree and spouses. Paid by individuals transferring property (collected by the notary). Fiscal Code art. 111.
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 111

rows.label: Wealth tax: special tax on high-value homes and cars (impozitul special pe bunurile imobile și mobile de valoare mare) [national]
rows.value: 0.9% of the value above RON 2,500,000 (homes) or of the purchase price above RON 375,000 (cars, for 5 years). Paid by owners of homes valued above RON 2.5 million and of cars bought for more than RON 375,000. Fiscal Code art. 500^1 to 500^3.
rows.note: Checklist item E3; detailed table: inheritance

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 500^1 and 500^2 (printed 5001, 5002), title X^1

rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (impozit pe moștenire și donații (art. 111)) [national]
rows.value: No tax on an inheritance settled within 2 years of death, otherwise 1% of the estate; gifts of real estate taxed like a sale (3% or 1%) except between relatives up to the third degree and spouses; no tax on other assets. Paid by heirs and donees of real estate. Fiscal Code art. 111 (2) and (3).
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 111

rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (impozitul pe mijloacele de transport) [municipal]
rows.value: Per 200 cm³ by engine size and Euro standard, e.g. cars up to 1,600 cm³ RON 16.5 (Euro 6) to RON 19.5 (Euro 0-3); over 3,000 cm³ RON 290.0 to RON 319.0. Paid by vehicle owners. Fiscal Code art. 468 to 472.
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 470

rows.label: Tourist promotion tax (special local tax) (taxă specială pentru promovarea turistică) [municipal]
rows.value: No national rate: local and county councils may adopt special taxes for tourist promotion under Law 273/2006. Paid by set by each local council (typically accommodation guests). Fiscal Code art. 484.
rows.note: Checklist item F3

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 484

rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax (taxă de plecare) [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax in the Fiscal Code's list of taxes. Paid by no one. Fiscal Code art. 2.
rows.note: Checklist item F4

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 2

rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 21% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance; EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC; Fiscal Code art. 291.
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs

source.title: EUR-Lex: Council Directive 2007/74/EC on the exemption from value added tax and excise duty of goods imported by persons travelling from third countries, Articles 7 to 11

rows.label: Administrative fees for certificates, permits and local procedures (taxe pentru eliberarea certificatelor, avizelor și autorizațiilor) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by local councils within statutory caps, e.g. sanitary operating authorisation up to RON 20; administrative divorce RON 500 (up to 50% more by local decision). Paid by applicants. Fiscal Code art. 473 to 476 and 486.
rows.note: Checklist item H1

source.title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 475 and 486

rows.label: Digital-nomad visa and new residents (expat regime) (viză de lungă ședere pentru nomazi digitali) [national]
rows.value: Nomad salary from a foreign employer untaxed while present no more than 183 days in 12 months; no inbound or expat tax regime. Paid by non-EU remote workers. OUG 194/2002 art. 2; Fiscal Code art. 228 and 59.
rows.note: Checklist item H3

rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension: privately managed pension fund (fondul de pensii administrat privat) [national]
rows.value: 4.75% of gross pay in 2026, redirected from the employee's 25% social insurance contribution (CAS); no extra charge. Paid by employees insured in the public pension system (contribution paid within CAS). Legea nr. 411/2004 art. 43 (4); Legea bugetului asigurărilor sociale de stat pe anul 2026.

rows.value: Ecotax and contributions under OUG 196/2005 (rates not stored: not read on an official page); the vehicle environmental stamp (timbrul de mediu) was repealed from 1 February 2017. Paid by producers, importers and sellers of the goods concerned, passed on in the price. OUG nr. 196/2005 privind Fondul pentru mediu; Legea nr. 1/2017 art. XII.

rows.value: None: the radio and television fee was abolished from 1 February 2017; public radio and television are funded from the state budget. Paid by nobody. Legea nr. 1/2017 art. IV (amending Legea nr. 41/1994 art. 40 and 41).

rows.value: Operating authorisation for restaurants, bars and recreation up to RON 4,000 (500 m²) or RON 8,000 a year; advertising displays up to RON 32 or 23 per m²; tax on shows up to 2% or 5% of receipts. Paid by businesses. Fiscal Code art. 475, 478 and 481.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C3
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 47, 51 and 52
rows.label: Simplified regime: micro-enterprise turnover tax (impozitul pe veniturile microîntreprinderilor) [national]
rows.value: 1% of turnover (from 1 January 2026); PFA income norms (norma de venit) for listed activities. Paid by companies with turnover up to EUR 100,000 and at least one employee. Fiscal Code art. 47 to 57 and 69.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item C4; detailed table: distributed-profits
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 223 alin. (2)
rows.label: Branch profits and distributed profits (sediu permanent; impozitul pe dividende; impozitul pe reprezentanțe) [national]
rows.value: No branch profits tax (branches pay 16% profit tax); 16% dividend withholding (exempt for 10% holdings held one year); representative offices of foreign companies RON 18,000 a year. Paid by branches of foreign companies; companies paying dividends; representative offices. Fiscal Code art. 43, 223 (2) and 236.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D1
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 291 alin. (1)-(2) and art. 310 alin. (1), (6)
rows.label: Value added tax (VAT) (taxa pe valoarea adăugată (TVA)) [national]
rows.value: 21% standard, 11% reduced; small-business exemption up to RON 395,000 a year. Paid by consumers (collected by VAT-registered businesses). Fiscal Code art. 291 and 310.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D2
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 2
rows.label: Local sales tax (taxă locală pe vânzări) [national]
rows.value: None: no regional or local sales or consumption tax in the Fiscal Code's list of taxes. Paid by no one. Fiscal Code art. 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D3; detailed table: excise-environment
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), title VIII, art. 342 and annex 1
rows.label: Excise duties (accize) [national]
rows.value: 2026: beer RON 5.83 per hl per degree Plato; still wine RON 11 per hl; ethyl alcohol RON 5,848.49 per hl of pure alcohol; cigarettes RON 718.97 per 1,000 (from 1 April); unleaded petrol RON 3,059.80 and diesel RON 2,804.29 per 1,000 litres; sugar-sweetened drinks RON 48.40 or 72.60 per hl. Paid by producers and importers (passed on to consumers). Fiscal Code title VIII, annexes 1 and 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D4
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 46^1 (printed 461), title II^1 'Impozit suplimentar'
rows.label: Digital services, insurance premium or financial transaction tax (impozit pe servicii digitale, prime de asigurare sau tranzacții financiare) [national]
rows.value: No digital services, insurance premium or financial transaction tax in the Fiscal Code's list; credit institutions pay an additional 4% tax on turnover in 2026 (2% for a market share below 0.2%). Paid by credit institutions (turnover tax). Fiscal Code art. 2 and 46^1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item D5
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), title VIII, art. 342 and annex 1
rows.label: Energy taxes: excise on electricity and natural gas (accize la energie electrică și gaz natural) [national]
rows.value: Electricity RON 2.37 per MWh (business use) or RON 4.74 (non-business); natural gas for heating RON 1.52 per GJ (non-business). Paid by suppliers (passed on to consumers). Fiscal Code title VIII, annex 1.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 457
rows.label: Property tax: buildings and land (impozitul pe clădiri și impozitul pe teren) [municipal]
rows.value: Residential buildings 0.08% to 0.2% of the taxable value (area × RON per m²); non-residential 0.2% to 1.3% (5% if not revalued for 5 years); land by area, locality rank and zone (e.g. RON 8,282 to 20,706 per ha, zone A, rank 0); rates set by each local council. Paid by owners of buildings and land. Fiscal Code art. 455 to 467.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E1; detailed table: property-tax
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 498
rows.label: Property tax: tax on constructions (impozitul pe construcții) [national]
rows.value: 0.5% of the net book value (0.25% of constructions held under concession or similar rights on public property). Paid by companies owning constructions not subject to building tax. Fiscal Code art. 496 to 499.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E2; detailed table: property-transfer
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 111
rows.label: Property transfer tax (impozitul pe venitul din transferul proprietăților imobiliare) [national]
rows.value: 3% of the transaction value for property held up to 3 years, 1% above; no tax on gifts between relatives up to the third degree and spouses. Paid by individuals transferring property (collected by the notary). Fiscal Code art. 111.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E3; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 500^1 and 500^2 (printed 5001, 5002), title X^1
rows.label: Wealth tax: special tax on high-value homes and cars (impozitul special pe bunurile imobile și mobile de valoare mare) [national]
rows.value: 0.9% of the value above RON 2,500,000 (homes) or of the purchase price above RON 375,000 (cars, for 5 years). Paid by owners of homes valued above RON 2.5 million and of cars bought for more than RON 375,000. Fiscal Code art. 500^1 to 500^3.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item E4; detailed table: inheritance
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 111
rows.label: Inheritance and gift tax (impozit pe moștenire și donații (art. 111)) [national]
rows.value: No tax on an inheritance settled within 2 years of death, otherwise 1% of the estate; gifts of real estate taxed like a sale (3% or 1%) except between relatives up to the third degree and spouses; no tax on other assets. Paid by heirs and donees of real estate. Fiscal Code art. 111 (2) and (3).

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F1; detailed table: vehicle-taxes
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 470
rows.label: Motor vehicle tax (impozitul pe mijloacele de transport) [municipal]
rows.value: Per 200 cm³ by engine size and Euro standard, e.g. cars up to 1,600 cm³ RON 16.5 (Euro 6) to RON 19.5 (Euro 0-3); over 3,000 cm³ RON 290.0 to RON 319.0. Paid by vehicle owners. Fiscal Code art. 468 to 472.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F3
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 484
rows.label: Tourist promotion tax (special local tax) (taxă specială pentru promovarea turistică) [municipal]
rows.value: No national rate: local and county councils may adopt special taxes for tourist promotion under Law 273/2006. Paid by set by each local council (typically accommodation guests). Fiscal Code art. 484.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F4
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 2
rows.label: Departure or air passenger tax (taxă de plecare) [national]
rows.value: None: no departure or air passenger tax in the Fiscal Code's list of taxes. Paid by no one. Fiscal Code art. 2.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item G1; detailed table: customs
rows.source_title: EUR-Lex: Council Directive 2007/74/EC on the exemption from value added tax and excise duty of goods imported by persons travelling from third countries, Articles 7 to 11
rows.label: Customs, import VAT and traveller allowances (taxe vamale, TVA la import) [EU]
rows.value: EU Common Customs Tariff; EUR 150 duty relief until 30 June 2026, then EUR 3 per item; 21% import VAT; EUR 430 / 300 traveller allowance; EUR 10,000 cash declaration. Paid by importers and travellers. Regulations (EC) 1186/2009, (EU) 2026/382 and 2018/1672; Directive 2007/74/EC; Fiscal Code art. 291.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H1
rows.source_title: ANAF: Legea nr. 227/2015 privind Codul fiscal, consolidated text with the methodological norms (last update: Legea nr. 204/2026), art. 475 and 486
rows.label: Administrative fees for certificates, permits and local procedures (taxe pentru eliberarea certificatelor, avizelor și autorizațiilor) [municipal]
rows.value: Set by local councils within statutory caps, e.g. sanitary operating authorisation up to RON 20; administrative divorce RON 500 (up to 50% more by local decision). Paid by applicants. Fiscal Code art. 473 to 476 and 486.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H3
rows.source_title: IGI (General Inspectorate for Immigration): Ordonanța de urgență nr. 194/2002 privind regimul străinilor în România, republished, consolidated form valid on 30 April 2026, art. 2 lit. n^4), art. 24, art. 30 alin. (7), art. 49 alin. (1) lit. f^1) and (2^1), art. 69
rows.label: Digital-nomad visa and new residents (expat regime) (viză de lungă ședere pentru nomazi digitali) [national]
rows.value: Nomad salary from a foreign employer untaxed while present no more than 183 days in 12 months; no inbound or expat tax regime. Paid by non-EU remote workers. OUG 194/2002 art. 2; Fiscal Code art. 228 and 59.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item B4
rows.source_title: Senatul României: Expunere de motive, Legea bugetului asigurărilor sociale de stat pe anul 2026 (Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Labour)
rows.label: Mandatory occupational pension: privately managed pension fund (fondul de pensii administrat privat) [national]
rows.value: 4.75% of gross pay in 2026, redirected from the employee's 25% social insurance contribution (CAS); no extra charge. Paid by employees insured in the public pension system (contribution paid within CAS). Legea nr. 411/2004 art. 43 (4); Legea bugetului asigurărilor sociale de stat pe anul 2026.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item F2
rows.source_title: ANAF: Codul fiscal și Normele metodologice (consolidated text), VAT norms to art. 286 (Environment Fund rates NOT READ)
rows.label: Environmental taxes: Environment Fund ecotax and contributions (ecotaxa și contribuții la Fondul pentru mediu) [national]
rows.value: Ecotax and contributions under OUG 196/2005 (rates not stored: not read on an official page); the vehicle environmental stamp (timbrul de mediu) was repealed from 1 February 2017. Paid by producers, importers and sellers of the goods concerned, passed on in the price. OUG nr. 196/2005 privind Fondul pentru mediu; Legea nr. 1/2017 art. XII.

rows.section: Taxes and charges in Romania: the complete list
rows.note: Checklist item H2
rows.source_title: Parlamentul României: Lege privind eliminarea unor taxe și tarife, precum și pentru modificarea și completarea unor acte normative (Law 1/2017, form sent for promulgation, signed 6 January 2017)
rows.label: Broadcasting licence fee (radio and TV fee) (taxa radio și TV) [national]
rows.value: None: the radio and television fee was abolished from 1 February 2017; public radio and television are funded from the state budget. Paid by nobody. Legea nr. 1/2017 art. IV (amending Legea nr. 41/1994 art. 40 and 41).
